utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—people have been dropping off tools and a few supplies already. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what still needs the most help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that so? Just to confirm, they still need more tools and supplies, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that’s right — they could still use more tools and a few supplies. I’ll let you know if I hear what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I might miss a few details, but I appreciate you spreading the word. Just let me know the time and place again when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll let everyone know as soon as I’ve got the time and place, and I’ll remind you too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what repair items do you want me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Could you bring some duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and a couple spare light bulbs? That should cover the basics.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring those.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet—what’s the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s for gathering tools, nails, and other basics so folks can patch up whatever’s broken around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. If you want, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup times, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send over the repair drive details, and we can line it up with school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — send them when you can, and I’ll work around pickup times once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Oren—let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs fixing and when you want to go.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Eli—my porch light is out and the gate sticks a bit. If you’re free tomorrow afternoon, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Tomorrow afternoon works for me—let’s start with the porch light, then I’ll take a look at the gate.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m already telling folks about the repair drive — happy to spread the word fast. If you want, I can invite a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, thanks — I’m just trying to make sure we have enough people and clear timing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep inviting neighbors and make sure they know the timing too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting organized, but I’m still piecing it together from the grapevine. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re pulling it together now — collecting repair requests, matching folks with volunteers, and setting a date for the first round. If you’ve got something that needs fixing, I can add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’m hearing a few things second-hand, so I’ll keep an eye out and send along any repair requests I catch. If you know the date once it’s set, I’d appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the exact date and what kinds of repairs you want included? I’d like to make sure I get the details right before we do anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’d like to keep it flexible for now—maybe Saturday, and mainly small household repairs like leaky faucets, loose door handles, and a few electrical fixes. If that works, I can help narrow it down further.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Saturday sounds good. Do you want me to note any specific priority, or should I keep it open for now?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s fair — I’ll keep it quiet and simple. Thanks for helping at all.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate you keeping it simple.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Gus. Do you have a hammer, screwdrivers, and maybe some duct tape?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got a hammer, a set of screwdrivers, and some duct tape you can borrow. Just swing by when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the repair drive spots if you want—just tell me where we’re starting and where we need to go next.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes—let’s start at my place, then the corner house, and after that the one by the park.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ve got your place first, then the corner house, then the one by the park.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand and a few tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’ll make a list of the first few fixes and bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll be ready when you bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and pickup details. Do we know where everything needs to go and by when?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I’d want that confirmed too—do we have the drop-off address and deadline nailed down?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, and I’d really like those confirmed before we move anything. Once we have the address and deadline, I can help sort the pickup plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help link folks up for the repair drive—want me to spread the word or help organize a few volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great, Jules — please spread the word and help line up a few volunteers. I’ll keep track of who’s coming and what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll start reaching out and see who can pitch in. I’ll loop back with a few names soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive—what do you need me to track?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo—could you track what comes in and what’s still needed? I’ll swing by a bit late, but I’ll help sort things when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ll keep a running list of what comes in and what we still need. Just let me know when you arrive, and I’ll have it ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard a few folks are already dropping things off for the repair drive. If you’re heading over, I can tell you what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, Tess — I’m trying to work around the school pickup, so what do they still need?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They’re still short on cleaning supplies, batteries, and a couple of hand tools. If you want, I can keep it quick and tell you the best time to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Could you help me keep track of who needs repairs and maybe follow up with a few neighbors? I’m organizing the list and could use an extra set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can do that. Send me the list and I’ll follow up with a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what kind of repair drive are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a quick neighborhood repair drive for small fixes and supplies. Nothing fancy — I’ll send the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Leo — send the details when you’re ready and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate you spreading the word. I’ll keep an eye out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll let folks know and nudge anyone who’s handy. I’ll come back with updates as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t got any repair-drive details yet, Eli, but I can keep track if you tell me the location.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Let’s keep it simple: once I know the location, I’ll bring the details by and we’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good, Eli—just let me know the location when you have it, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — is the repair drive still on for this weekend, and what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, it’s still on for this weekend. I’m just confirming the exact start time now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana — just let me know the time when you have it. I’ll plan to be there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m heading out on errands anyway, so I’ll keep an ear out for any updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate it. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll check back in if I hear anything while I’m out.
